method_name: AutoTemplate core on official RXNMapper 0.3.0 remapping (upstream workflow)
upstream_workflow: README step (1) rxnmapper_mapping.py, then step (2) auto_process.py --radius 0 --threshold 5 --retain_reagents
implementation: Unchanged upstream chemistry functions through the verified Windows wrapper in ../source_mapping/run_comparison.py; not execution of the unmodified upstream CLI processes.

atom_mapper.package: rxnmapper==0.3.0 (official PyPI wheel, pinned in upstream docs/environment.yml), unpacked to _deps/site; not the RXNMapper_v2 fork installed in rxnmapper_v2_env
atom_mapper.validation: All three expected maps in the package's tests/test_mapper.py reproduced exactly (mapper_selftest.json)
atom_mapper.runtime_difference: PyTorch 2.11/Transformers 4.46/RDKit 2026.03 instead of the pinned torch 1.13/transformers 4.30.2/older RDKit

mapper_input: Lowe reactant and agent sections folded into the precursor side (as in the source-mapped run), original Indigo atom maps removed so inputs are unmapped like Reaxys records, then upstream ValidRxnSmiles unchanged (isotopes cleared, reduce_radical=False).
mapping_batches: Benchmark: one reaction per call, as upstream. Corpus: length-sorted batches of 8 for throughput; a failing batch is redone one reaction at a time. Batched and single-call maps were identical for all 400 benchmark reactions.
mapping_failures: Upstream silently drops records RXNMapper or ValidRxnSmiles cannot handle (e.g. >512 tokens). They are recorded here; corpus rows contribute no template and benchmark rows count as incorrect.
reference_pool: All 1808937 Lowe USPTO grant source reactions, remapped, including benchmark source records. Pooled corpus library because USPTO lacks the per-reaction-class datasets upstream processes separately. Transductive comparator, not independent validation.
no_change_return: Upstream RemoveReagent returns a bare string for a reaction with no change; with --retain_reagents the pinned CLI would fail to unpack it. Primary: pass the reaction through with nothing removed, as the CLI's no-retain path does. Sensitivity: count these records as failures, as the source-mapped run did.
skip_top_n_templates: Primary follows the pinned CLI's actual behaviour: its per-record template remains None, so no record is skipped and all are re-templated. Variant: upstream's intended branch, where a benchmark record whose own extracted template (resolved to its merged representative) is among the top 3 library templates is kept as preprocessed with give_mapnum_for_unmapped_reactant_atoms.
role_assignment: Same as the source-mapped run: curated core classified by positive product-map overlap, then upstream removed_reagents appended to the reagent role; naive merged-SMILES classification reported as a diagnostic.
product_selection: First successful product in upstream preprocessed order
template_order: Descending merged frequency; stable source-row order for ties
seed: numpy seed = 20261027 + zero-based source or benchmark index; PYTHONHASHSEED=0

timeout_seconds_per_record.note: Upstream has no per-record limit; these generous caps replace the earlier 60 s condition. Remaining timeouts count as incorrect.

benchmark_failures: All 400 retained in denominators; mapping failures, exceptions, timeouts and worker crashes count as incorrect for both labels.
noise_prediction: retained => noise-free; completed no_template_match => noisy; execution failure => unresolved
primary_structure: Frozen Table 2 role-specific normalization and reactant multiplicity policy; denominator all 292 noise-free records; incomplete references and method failures cannot count as exact
secondary_structure: Frozen strict Table 2 endpoint and pooled reactant/reagent set sensitivity, reported separately
comparators: Earlier source-mapped AutoTemplate run (per-record flags must reproduce)
statistics: Wilson 95% intervals; exact paired McNemar tests of the primary RXNMapper run against each comparator, Holm-corrected within endpoint
pilots: Mapper speed/memory pilots on the first 6000 and 12000 source rows and a 3000-row runner smoke test; no benchmark labels or scores used to choose settings
